pages.title: Três selos
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Inside the school council chamber, Eda on LEFT spreads three distinct sealed permits across a wooden table while Ordelia on RIGHT verifies them. Both mature women remain fully visible; no extra people.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Talveira aceita observadores. Cada margem impõe seus próprios limites.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: E a Casa autoriza apenas os estudantes nomeados.

pages.title: Licença não é posse
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Tovo on LEFT, the large green-skinned adult orc, asks about bringing a stone home; Eda on RIGHT points to clauses of three permits at council table. No other people.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Posso trazer uma pedra de lá?

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Só se o dono a oferecer. Encontrar não é possuir.

pages.title: Rota sem atalhos
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Avel on LEFT draws a journey map on a broad table; Ysra on RIGHT marks the guarded forest service gate. The map is an ordinary physical map with road, ferry and forest, no portal open in the room.

lines.speaker: Avel
lines.text: Estrada, balsa, Hessa e passagem vigiada. Só então Talveira.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: A costura de Porto das Cinzas continua lacrada.

pages.title: Funções definidas
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Caio on LEFT checks a wind measuring ribbon and field ledger while Sere on RIGHT, forest green cloak and one white braid, checks safety equipment beside packed boxes in school courtyard. Professional coordination with a warm but restrained look.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Oru assina minha avaliação. Os números seguem para Beren.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: E eu respondo pela segurança da travessia.

pages.title: A leitura lacrada
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Líria on LEFT with two long copper-brown braids and burgundy-trimmed earth-mage robe hands her dated geological fracture sketch to Beren on RIGHT at archive counter. Exactly one Líria. No Runa.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Minha leitura da fratura vai com recibo. Runa não tocará no original.

lines.speaker: Beren
lines.text: A autoria fica registrada. Farei uma cópia de trabalho.

pages.title: Carta anterior à pergunta
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Ilyan alone in his school room sits fully clothed at a desk with a received paper letter and practical tools; wistful face, not a vision of Nima. One envelope with normal postal seal.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Esta carta saiu antes da minha. Ela ainda não sabe que ouvi a verdade.

pages.title: Sanções assinadas
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Runa on LEFT, long straight black hair with bangs, floral left-arm tattoo, faces Ordelia on RIGHT across a formal council desk. Signed disciplinary papers visible. Runa furious but composed; no Líria physically present.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Depois de tudo, Líria continua na Casa?

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Sob proibição de combate e reparação. Sua própria infração também consta.

pages.title: A carroça pronta
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Ilyan on LEFT and Runa on RIGHT secure labeled measuring boxes onto a covered wagon in school courtyard at dusk. Their hands briefly meet over one box, tentative trust but not all distrust resolved. Exactly two people.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Posso levar esta caixa?

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Pode. O que falta conversar ainda vai conosco.

pages.title: A balsa de Adra
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Wide view of a sturdy medieval ferry crossing a real river at dusk. Adra the established ferrywoman at helm, covered wagon firmly lashed on deck, visible riverbanks, all passengers distant silhouettes only; no magical shortcut.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Hessa fica na outra margem. Chegaremos antes do escuro.

pages.title: Nomes na passagem
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Ysra on LEFT checks written names and tools with Tovo on RIGHT at the guarded service passage among living tree roots. Gatekeepers are outside frame; solid ground and clear path, no instant teleportation.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: A passagem abre apenas durante a contagem.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Então seguimos juntos e voltamos juntos.

pages.title: Duas luas entre folhas
pages.layout: Single wide cinematic establishing illustration, with continuous architecture and clear depth
pages.scene: Full-page landscape: a continuous forest trail beyond a rooted guarded passage, two pale moons visible behind leaves in the same sky, basalt stones and travelers only as tiny distant silhouettes. No floating terrain or cut horizon.
pages.narration: Tovo percebeu as duas luas quando o grupo já caminhava dentro do Entremeio.

pages.title: Talveira
pages.layout: Single wide cinematic establishing illustration, with continuous architecture and clear depth
pages.scene: Grand uninterrupted panorama of Talveira: inhabited fantasy city on terraces above a gorge, porous stone homes, running water canals, milky glass bridge PLATES held by dark metal arches and pillars, market stalls and working people small in distance. Bridges are structurally supported, not floating.
pages.narration: Talveira surgiu sobre a garganta: uma cidade de casas, canais, trabalho e pontes que podiam quebrar.

pages.title: A ponte interditada
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: In Talveira council courtyard, Ysra on LEFT presents sealed permits; Eda on RIGHT records local testimony while a closed glass bridge and physical barricade remain in background. Other residents outside close frame, only two adult foreground speakers.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Viemos medir e ajudar. O conselho de Talveira decide suas pontes.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Também vou registrar quanto tempo o desvio custa às famílias.

pages.title: O desvio do mercado
pages.layout: Single wide cinematic establishing illustration, with continuous architecture and clear depth
pages.scene: Street-level environmental scene in Talveira: a market delivery cart detours around a safely barricaded glass bridge, a local mother carrying medicine boxes takes a long stone stair with railing, busy vendors, working city. No named cast close to camera.
pages.narration: A ponte fechada transformou uma entrega curta numa volta pela garganta.

pages.title: Água emprestada
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Runa on LEFT takes a measured sample of existing canal water with a marked glass rod and bucket, Ysra on RIGHT watches by permission of channel keeper offscreen. All water connected to the visible canal; stone rim warms under Runa's palm; no endless conjured water.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A saída está mais quente. Vou reduzir o fluxo antes de testar de novo.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Anote também a água que deve continuar nas casas.

pages.title: A rajada que não veio
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Caio on LEFT holds a wind ribbon near a cracked but barricaded glass bridge; Sere on RIGHT in green watches from a separate safe station. He deliberately stops his magic hand before pushing wind toward the cracked pane. Clearly different human and elf.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Se eu empurrar, aumento a pressão na placa.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Então mede. Não transforma a rajada em prova.

pages.title: Tampa de outra liga
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: In Talveira maintenance workshop, Ilyan on LEFT and Oru on RIGHT inspect an old heat-exchange tube with a visibly newer metal cap. Oru's gloved hand guards contact; Ilyan does not touch hot metal. No open bodily portal, intact filter and pipe connections.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Esta tampa é nova. A marca humana da forja continua no tubo.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Medimos primeiro. Sua mão fica longe da peça.

pages.title: Livro da oficina
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Eda on LEFT places a clean copying sheet beside an aged repair ledger; Ilyan on RIGHT studies a technical correction. Original book remains open under archival weights; no floating hands.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: A oficina guarda o original. Copiamos na presença das testemunhas.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Há um desenho corrigido na segunda folha.

pages.title: Quatro entalhes
pages.layout: Single wide cinematic establishing illustration, with continuous architecture and clear depth
pages.scene: Close still life of one historical ledger page showing an OLD technical drawing of a heat tube joint, four simple notches and a cartographic curve drawn in ink; physical paper fibers, archival weights, ruler. No legible invented words, no human hand.
pages.narration: O traço da correção coincidia com o caderno autenticado de Mira. Não revelava onde ela estava agora.

pages.title: Duas datas
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Eda on LEFT writes a chain-of-custody record while Ysra on RIGHT compares two independent dated receipts and original ledger. Full attached arms and hands, all documents on table. Calm evidentiary work, no magical vision.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: As duas datas são posteriores ao desaparecimento em Pedra-Mansa.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Prova a presença dela aqui. Não o destino atual.

pages.title: Mira errava e corrigia
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Oru on LEFT, elderly short white-braided master, speaks gently of Mira; Ilyan on RIGHT holds authorized copy of her technical correction in workshop. No ghost or image of Mira.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Sua mãe errou uma medição pública e voltou para corrigir.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Quero conhecer a mulher inteira, não só a lenda.

pages.title: A fratura de Líria
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Back at the school, Líria on LEFT with copper-brown twin braids edits her own geological report; Beren on RIGHT receives it by archive desk. Runa is not present. Clearly separate location from Talveira, ordinary messenger paperwork.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Minha fratura é antiga. O calor recente pode agravá-la.

lines.speaker: Beren
lines.text: Seu crédito fica no relatório. A ofensa pessoal, fora dele.

pages.title: A haste extra
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: At the human shore's locked pump depot, Hessa on LEFT and Maelor on RIGHT compare a purchase ledger with an actual extra heat-conducting metal rod. Pump housing and sealed evidence chest visible. Neither claims guilt from appearance alone.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: A haste foi comprada, mas não consta do desenho aprovado.

lines.speaker: Maelor
lines.text: Meu gabinete responderá pelos recibos. Lacre o livro.

pages.title: Resposta pela estrada
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Adra pilots the ordinary ferry carrying a sealed document pouch across the river toward guarded forest route. Weather and ropes continuous; no instantaneous magical message or overlapping landscapes.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: O relatório chegará a Talveira depois da passagem.

pages.narration: A resposta levou dois dias entre balsa, estrada e guardiões.

pages.title: Água que volta
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Runa alone at a canal test basin, black hair, floral tattoos, guides a THIN stream of existing cold water along a crack then returns it to connected channel. Her left hand trembles slightly, she sits at safe stone step. No other figure or extra limb.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Menos força. Deixo a água seguir o próprio peso.

pages.title: Uma fibra seca
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Oru on LEFT supervises Ilyan on RIGHT safely lighting exactly one dry fiber using warmth from his palm in a Talveira workshop. Tiny flame in glass cup, extinguisher bucket, no vast fire.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Uma fibra. Pare antes do tremor.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Uma luz pequena ainda pode bastar.

pages.title: Distância nomeada
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: On safe stone steps of Talveira at night, Runa on LEFT rests her slightly trembling hand beside a closed notebook; Ilyan on RIGHT sits a respectful arm's length away. City and glass bridges behind, faces openly visible, no kiss.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Prefiro esta distância dita em voz alta ao silêncio antigo.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Ainda sinto raiva. Posso escutar você mesmo assim.

pages.title: Números da margem humana
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Beren on LEFT opens a messenger pouch with measured drawings from Hessa, Eda on RIGHT marks delivery time on Talveira workshop table. Two adults only, physical papers and seal.

lines.speaker: Beren
lines.text: A haste toca a parede do tubo. Faltou o espaçador poroso.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Então o calor cruza onde a junta devia isolá-lo.

pages.title: Duas causas
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Beren on LEFT draws two intersecting curves in chalk on slate floor: older fracture and recent warming; Runa on RIGHT checks canal measurements. A cracked bridge visible through arch, no magical equations or readable invented labels.

lines.speaker: Beren
lines.text: Fratura velha e haste nova se somam.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Nas noites sem vento, a água aqueceu mais depressa.

pages.title: Duas autorizações
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Eda on LEFT and Ysra on RIGHT stand at Talveira council desk with two sealed permit folders. Closed bridge beyond. They plan evacuation and repair but keep tube physically sealed.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Não abriremos a tampa sem decisão das duas margens.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Até lá, fechamos as pontes e reforçamos os canais.

pages.title: Recibos preservados
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: At human pump depot Hessa on LEFT seals original purchase receipts while Maelor on RIGHT writes his signed version of disputed verbal order. Stationary pump visibly switched OFF; no unknown culprit depicted.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Duas versões assinadas. A bomba fica parada até a inspeção.

lines.speaker: Maelor
lines.text: Não vou culpar um carregador sem provas.

pages.title: Calor que fica
pages.layout: Single wide cinematic establishing illustration, with continuous architecture and clear depth
pages.scene: Atmospheric close view of glass bridge plates with hairline expansion cracks, physical metal supports, warm canal runoff under the glass despite an inactive pipe. No person, no monster visible, no scene collage.
pages.narration: Parar a bomba não esfriou de imediato a pedra, a água nem o vidro já dilatado.

pages.title: Segundo estalo
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Sere on LEFT closes a sturdy barricade at third Talveira bridge while Caio on RIGHT plants wind-direction ribbons safely away from cracked glass. Both are fully clothed and identifiable, no additional named cast.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Fechem os acessos agora.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: A rajada vira para a escada de serviço.

pages.title: A talha sustenta
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Tovo alone, correctly proportioned strong adult green-skinned orc, works a manual pulley and wooden shore under bridge arch. He uses ONE brief strength pulse to prevent a slipping worker only suggested off-panel, then grips his sore shoulder. No extra arms or duplicate Tovo.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Passe o peso à talha. Meu ombro não é escora.

pages.title: Caçador sob o vidro
pages.layout: Single wide cinematic establishing illustration, with continuous architecture and clear depth
pages.scene: Under one structurally supported milky glass bridge plate, a SMALL translucent nonhumanoid Salt Deep predator with irregular rib-like transparent structures surrounding a dark hollow body follows heat line. Entire creature visible beneath glass, no tentacle touching humans, no giant demon, no collage.
pages.narration: O caçador do Fundo de Sal seguiu a linha quente sob a ponte interditada.

pages.title: A escada de serviço
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Sere alone in foreground on the safe upper landing checks the service stair with solid rail and visible alternate route around the bridge. In distant background two local children and one adult artisan await guidance behind barrier, realistically scaled, no perilous dangling.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: As três pessoas do mercado saem pela escada. Ninguém pisa no vidro.

pages.title: Três medidas antes da chama
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Oru on LEFT checks Ilyan's pulse with gloved hand at unlit service stair lantern; Ilyan on RIGHT counts dry wicks in a cup. Smoke exit and extinguisher bucket visible, no huge flame.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Pavios, pulso e saída da fumaça.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Uma luz se a lamparina apagar. Não aquecerei a ponte.

pages.title: Retirada pela escada
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Ysra at a safe stone landing calls roll from a written list while Talveira residents ascend a solid service stair in orderly line, glass bridge barricaded in background. One Ysra, believable group scale and railing.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Artesã, duas crianças. Digam seus nomes ao chegar.

pages.title: Conte os degraus
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Sere, adult dark-skinned elf with one long white braid, guides a frightened local child up narrow stone service stairs with solid railing; child holds a leather strap of her green cloak. Natural adult-child size difference and anatomically correct hands.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Olhe meus pés. Só faltam três degraus.

pages.title: Vento sem pressão
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Caio alone by the stone stair directs a very gentle existing breeze away from the stair fog, measured ribbons attached to wall. His hand stops before pushing wind toward cracked glass, full body adult scale.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Devagar. A névoa sai sem levar a rajada ao vidro.

pages.title: A borda resfriada
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Runa alone at canal rim guides a narrow stream of EXISTING cold canal water into groove beside sealed filter, then back into connected waterway. Small controlled magic, no water weapon, both hands visible and attached, canal not drained.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Só a borda. As casas ainda precisam desta água.

pages.title: Minutos comprados
pages.layout: Single wide cinematic establishing illustration, with continuous architecture and clear depth
pages.scene: View from outside safely barricaded milky glass bridge: small translucent ribbed predator retreats beneath a second intact panel while three local evacuees are distant on solid stair landing. Architectural supports and separation clear; creature not destroyed.
pages.narration: A água mudou o caminho do caçador. A retirada ganhou minutos, não uma vitória definitiva.

pages.title: Uma luz para três passos
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: On the service stair landing an extinguished lamp sits beside Ilyan on LEFT; he lights exactly one fiber in a glass cup using warmth from his palm, a small guiding flame. Oru on RIGHT monitors his pulse and brings warm cloth. No bonfire and no extra fingers.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A última criança precisa ver o degrau.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Acenda uma fibra. Depois sente-se.

pages.title: O degrau faltante
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Sere on LEFT guides the last local child over a worn missing stone stair tread using a secure rail; a tiny protected lamp glows nearby. Child is safe and fully clothed, correct limbs; no Ilyan duplicate.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Agora o corrimão. Isso, você chegou.

pages.narration: A pequena chama de Ilyan bastou para mostrar onde pôr o pé.

pages.title: Um pulso, um calço
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Beren on LEFT passes a wooden wedge to Tovo on RIGHT, green adult orc with sore shoulder; Tovo uses one brief strength pulse to fit it under manual pulley on solid maintenance platform. Full attached arms, no impossible load.

lines.speaker: Beren
lines.text: O calço, agora.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Só um batimento. Depois a talha segura.

pages.title: Falta um nome
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: At safe assembly court Ysra on LEFT counts a list of evacuated residents, Eda on RIGHT checks time and a separate search route map. Empty space on list suggests one watchman missing, no panicked mass scene.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: O vigia não está na lista.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Confirmemos a rota longa antes de chamar a ponte.

pages.title: O vigia voltou
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: At Talveira safe courtyard Ysra greets an adult local watchman with dusty boots who returns by ordinary long road carrying a satchel. Full figures, no duplicate, surrounding residents relieved but distant.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Ele avisou a casa afastada. Agora todos estão contados.

pages.title: A haste sai
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: At sealed human-side pump chamber Hessa on LEFT supervises a MANUAL pulley extracting the unsuitable metal rod, Eda on RIGHT records agreed hour; porous spacer and intact filter on table. Workers outside close crop, no wide-open portal or creature.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: A haste saiu. O filtro permanece fechado.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Talveira encaixa o espaçador na hora combinada.

pages.narration: As duas equipes seguiram licenças e relógios separados. O calor caiu aos poucos.

pages.title: A primeira travessia
pages.layout: Single wide cinematic establishing illustration, with continuous architecture and clear depth
pages.scene: Repaired physically supported milky glass bridge in Talveira opens to local residents. Two adult women carry medicine boxes across after mechanical wind-safety bell, watched from afar by school visitors. All bridge joints and dark metal arches believable, no floating architecture.
pages.narration: Dois dias depois do reparo, Talveira reabriu a travessia para os próprios moradores.

pages.title: Cicatriz de ponte
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Tovo on LEFT with wrapped recovering shoulder studies the new bridge joint; Runa on RIGHT observes the seamless glass repair while they stand on safe stone margin. No rivalry conversation here, gentle reflection, both full figures.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Uma placa diferente não faz a ponte menor.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: E um rosto sem marca não conta tudo que aconteceu.

pages.title: A régua guardada
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: In Talveira workshop Ilyan on LEFT and Oru on RIGHT study an authorized clear glass alignment ruler over a map, its four-notch mark and line descending under city visible. Original ruler rests on padded table, no taking it away.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A última linha desce sob a cidade. É o sinal de Mira.

lines.speaker: Oru
lines.text: Copiamos a marca. O original fica aqui.

pages.title: Passagem selada
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Ysra on LEFT shows Ilyan on RIGHT the exterior of a SEALED stone service passage below Talveira, massive intact door with physical locking bars and warning markers, neither touches latch. Safe walkway, no demon emerging.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Ela desce perto do Fundo de Sal. Está isolada por acordo.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Não vou pedir que a abram por causa de um traço.

pages.title: O caminho de volta
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Caio on LEFT and Sere on RIGHT ride in covered wagon on the established guarded forest return route, two separate maps on their laps, fingers briefly touch naturally as wagon jolts. Both fully clothed, adult scale, no more than two foreground people.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: O mapa ainda mostra o desvio do mercado.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Então nosso relatório precisa mostrar quando ele terminou.

pages.narration: Voltaram pelas mesmas trilhas, passagem vigiada, pousada, balsa e estrada.

pages.title: Resposta de Nima
pages.layout: Single-character medium scene, grounded background, upper background reserved for one compact balloon
pages.scene: Ilyan alone at school desk reads a newly delivered ordinary postal letter from absent Nima, slight relieved smile, separate earlier sent envelope on shelf. Nima not depicted or hallucinated.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A mão melhora. Ela quer conversar quando tivermos tempo.

pages.title: Relatórios sem paz
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: Líria on LEFT, copper-brown twin braids and earth mage robe, stands across archive corridor from Runa on RIGHT, black hair, bangs, septum ring, floral left arm tattoo. Two separate technical report copies in their own hands; hostile expressions, ample physical distance, no fight and no reconciliation.

lines.speaker: Líria
lines.text: Sua água não sustentaria a ponte sem minha escora.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: E sua escora racharia sem o resfriamento. Não me procure.

pages.title: A linha sob Talveira
pages.layout: Two-character dialogue or action scene, first speaker at image left and second at image right, clear upper background for compact balloons
pages.scene: In familiar school Hall of Elements, Ilyan on LEFT and Runa on RIGHT study a copy of glass ruler map between empty water basin and cold brazier. Runa's finger rests on final sealed passage mark; faces unobscured, no Mira vision, no embrace.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Mira pode ter parado ali, voltado ou seguido.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Então buscamos testemunhos antes de abrir qualquer porta.

pages.narration: A pista ganhou uma direção. A passagem continuava fechada.
